board: STM32H7B3I-DK (STM32H7B3LIH6Q, CPU 280 MHz, AXI 140 MHz, direct SMPS), powered from the laptop's USB port (ST-LINK CN14) through the meter; LCD, SDRAM, Octo-SPI flash and Wi-Fi module not initialised by the firmware
firmware: firmware/stm32h7b3i_dk, app bnn (common/Src/main_bnn.cc), one-bit encoder reactnet_64-5-384_seed42_lce.tflite with TensorFlow Lite Micro and Larq Compute Engine reference kernels; the loop runs the byte-table lookup and Invoke() on the first test title
meter: Joy-IT JT-UM120 USB tester, between the laptop's USB port and the board; display resolution 1 mV, 1 mA, 1 mW as read
regulator: board 3.3 V regulator not documented in UM2569 (MCU current jumper JP2), so no MCU-side energy is derived
read_by: the experimenter, from the meter's display, 2026-10-19 at about 14:20
phase_times: not logged (no serial listener during the readings); the loop phase ran from the end of the start-up report (12:21) until the first button press
